circuit.scope: Right optic-lobe radius-2 patch; 11 selected types, traced cells with assignedOlHex coordinates. Induced measured edges only. Outside cells and connections omitted. Column mapping is anatomical; optical sampling and projection are simplified engineering assumptions.

protocol: 256 training / 64 validation / 128 independent test clips. Fixed epochs; validation is displayed but not used to select weights. Test evaluated before and after training, never optimized. All models see identical scenes and minibatch orders. No pretrained checkpoint. Rates and dynamics are engineered, not measured physiology.
anatomy_note: This spatial patch omits T4/T5 and all exterior connections. Inputs enter L1/L2/L3 at their annotated columns; the eye_* models add a trainable photoreceptor adaptation stage and column projection in front, an engineered stand-in for photoreceptor physiology and neural superposition. Readout pools Tm1/Tm2/Tm9. Hex sampling is a planar local approximation, not an optical eye model. Learned signs and weights are unconstrained; synapse counts do not initialize strengths.
